architecture.titleB: where algorithms and models each play their part
architecture.intro: We refuse AI for AI's sake. Memory scheduling is handled by an explainable math engine (FSRS forgetting curve + edit-distance grading); language generation is handled by a domain-fine-tuned neural model — determinism guarantees pedagogical rigor, generative power guarantees endlessly fresh content.
architecture.symbolic1: · FSRS forgetting curve: millisecond-level solving of stability S / difficulty D / retrievability R
architecture.symbolic2: · Levenshtein edit distance: zero-error spelling grading
architecture.symbolic3: · RME multi-objective matching: precisely recalls due words from the lexicon
architecture.neural1: · CEFR-level constraints: vocabulary difficulty locked within the learner's level
architecture.neural2: · Target-word slot injection: due words woven seamlessly into real contexts
architecture.neural3: · Structured output: bilingual JSON + vocabulary explanations
architecture.neural4: · Traits: unlimited content, personalized, runs on-device
architecture.edgeSub: Qwen2.5-1.5B + domain-fine-tuned LoRA (full SFT + DPO pipeline)
architecture.edgePoint1: · WebGPU 4-bit quantization, ~950MB — offline forever after the first download
architecture.edgePoint2: · Student data never leaves the browser (GDPR / COPPA friendly)
architecture.edgePoint3: · Zero marginal inference cost → equally usable in underdeveloped regions

training.titleA: WordLink-Edge, a 1.5B model born for teaching,
training.intro: Built on Qwen2.5-1.5B and domain-fine-tuned through a full pipeline of diverse-corpus SFT and DPO on real failure negatives — all genuinely trained on local Apple Silicon. A small model that matches its commercial-flagship teacher, and lives in the browser offline forever.
training.heroBadge: Same model, +25pp · matches the DeepSeek-V3 teacher (97.78%)
training.barsLabel: Same Questions Compared · Why Domain Fine-Tuning Is a Must
training.card1Desc: Negatives all come from the 7B model's real failure outputs; four acceptance checks all passed with zero reward hacking — validating alignment safety, not gaming metrics.
training.card2Desc: WebGPU 4-bit on-device inference — zero network and zero marginal cost after the first download; student data never leaves the device (GDPR / COPPA friendly) — equally usable in low-connectivity regions.
training.card3Desc: DeepSeek-V3 teacher generation × 44 topics × A2/B1/B2 tiers, five hard filters (90.5% pass rate); de-duplicated against the test set by prompt for auditable evaluation hygiene.
training.footnote: * All metrics are computed by an automated evaluator on real model outputs (temperature=0, greedy decoding); evaluation details and per-question outputs are stored in the repository at outputs/eval/. Word hit = share of due review words naturally embedded in the text; JSON compliance = share of structured outputs directly consumable by programs.
training.reportLink: View the full model technical report (data engineering / SFT / DPO / MPS engineering / artifact list)

stage1.title: Data Factory
stage1.desc: Teacher model generates diverse micro-stories; CEFR word list + difficulty band + structure — five hard filters; 2,045 entries selected (90.5% pass rate)

stage2.title: SFT Supervised Fine-Tuning
stage2.desc: LoRA r=64 injection; learns target-word slot injection + CEFR boundaries + JSON structured output

stage3.title: DPO Preference Alignment
stage3.desc: All negatives from the model's real failure outputs; trust-region CLIP prevents degradation; margins genuinely climb 0→11

stage4.title: Automated Evaluation
stage4.desc: 90-question benchmark · greedy decoding · four dimensions: hit rate, out-of-bounds rate, JSON compliance, FKGL difficulty

stage5.title: On-Device Quantized Export
stage5.desc: 4-bit quantization → WebGPU in-browser inference; ~950MB, offline forever after the first download

dpo.note: On par with SFT, more stable behavior

gallery.intro: All of the following are real screenshots of the running product (not design mockups). Every module is one click away from a live experience.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.desc: Your post-login learning hub: lexicon, study modes, star map and quiz entries one screen away, with day/night themes that follow your habits

study.title: Star-Map Workbench
study.desc: Lexicon outline × word details × fission star map, three panes in sync: select any word and its synonym network unfolds instantly in a force-directed star map

navigator.title: Cognitive Navigator
navigator.desc: Gap analysis between your mastered vocabulary and target exam, generating a personalized learning path so every minute counts

quiz.title: Smart Quiz
quiz.desc: Three question types — multiple choice, spelling, recall — generated intelligently with a memory-strength model; every answer updates your forgetting curve

immersive.title: Immersive Star Map
immersive.desc: A full-screen force-directed star map with draggable floating panels — your library and word details hover above the galaxy, and every node click fissions further

ambient.title: Four-Season Ambient
ambient.desc: Real scenes of spring, summer, autumn and winter plus natural soundscapes synthesized in real time with Web Audio — words drift by with the passing landscape

read.title: Context Reading
read.desc: A graded article stream: click any word while reading for instant definitions, save it to your wordbook with one tap — reading is reviewing

passport.title: Learning Passport
passport.desc: AI translates all your learning data into an explainable English credential narrative + cognitive radar, making learning outcomes visible

report.title: Learning Report
report.desc: Streaks, accuracy trends, vocabulary mastery distribution and recent activity — your progress at a glance

libraries.title: My Libraries
libraries.desc: Built-in syllabus wordbooks plus custom libraries in any combination — grouped study, import and export on demand

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Interface language, sound, display and learning preferences all adjustable, with seamless Chinese-English bilingual switching

hero.badge: Introducing AI-powered vocabulary fission & contextual self-healing
hero.subtitle: Stunning cognitive topology. Blazing retention. Built by FSRS-6, refined by authentic contexts. This is vocabulary learning, wildly reimagined.

bento1.para: Every sentence is intentional. In our four-season ambient focus space, sentences emerge with liquid-glass staggered reveal, paired with synthesized Web Audio nature soundscapes and authentic IndexTTS voices.

bento2.para: Your vocabulary stream evolves with your learning state. The Playlist Vocabulary Hub allows real-time syllabus selection, shuffle curation, and cadence pacing (8s/12s/16s). Zero UI discipline ensures seamless passive learning.

cta.heading: You dream it. We anchor it.
cta.para: Connect every word into a second brain. FSRS-6 handles memory curves, RME-V5 serves the contexts, and AI Dictation closes the loop.
